description:
Get information about a Top Level Domain (TLD).

Returns:
- Description and typical use case
- Price range
- Any special restrictions
- Popularity and recommendations

Example:
- tld_info("io") → info about .io domains

detailed.description: Include detailed information. Defaults to false.

tld.description: The TLD to get info about (e.g., 'com', 'io', 'dev').

name: tld_info
